name: Lupicraft
summary:
Lupicraft is a Minecraft SMP project by Twitch Creator Lupisora, bringing players and creators from different communities together in a shared world.

A light roleplay server focused on player-driven stories, exploration, quests, events, and building your own place in the world. Follow story-driven quests, form alliances, start rivalries, meet new people, and create your own adventures.
